thread:
Maya: Quick draft for v2.14 internal announce + rollback criteria. Change window 09:00-10:00 PT. Need blast owner and canary lead.

Jon: Share the blurb and rollback thresholds, I can review fast.

Maya: Draft blurb:
"Rolling v2.14 today 09:00-10:00 PT. Highlights: smarter batching, per-route model pinning, fix for streaming KV cache. Canary -> staged rollout -> full. Oncall: Jon, Priya. If you see issues, post here and in #support."

Maya: Proposed rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >1.2% for 5m OR p99 latency >850ms for 10m OR token cost +20% sustained 10m.

Priya: I'll take canary watch and pin rotation. Plan: 5m smoke, 25m stability, then scale to 10% traffic. If anything off -> call rollback.

Jon: Copy is fine, small edit: change "smarter batching" to "batching improvements" for clarity. I'll sign off on rollback thresholds.

Maya: Updated blast copy and locking in Maria to post. Maria?

Priya: deploy-bot command we'll use: `/deploy target=canary version=v2.14 timeout=30m` and rollback command: `/deploy rollback target=production to_version=v2.13 owner=@Priya reason="<short reason>"`. Keep rollback playbook at https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/rollback-playbook handy.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary -> staging | version=v2.14 | scheduled=09:00 PT | cmd=`/deploy target=canary version=v2.14 timeout=30m`

Jon: OK team. Final call before 08:45 PT cutoff. Using this thread as the live log during the window.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 09:00 PT  canary id=cb-1799900000. Health checks running.

Priya: First 10m look clean. No 5xx spikes and p99 ~420ms. Continuing to monitor.

Maya: Thanks. Maria to post internal blast at 09:30 PT if canary stays green for 30m.

Jon: On standby for escalation.

Priya: Canary health nominal at 09:25 PT. Ready to proceed with staged rollout after 30m window.

Maya: Great work team, will archive notes and file the release summary after the rollout.
